comment:
* PagerTitleStrip is a non-interactive indicator of the current, next, * and previous pages of a {@link ViewPager}. It is intended to be used as a * child view of a ViewPager widget in your XML layout. * Add it as a child of a ViewPager in your layout file and set its * android:layout_gravity to TOP or BOTTOM to pin it to the top or bottom * of the ViewPager. The title from each page is supplied by the method * {@link PagerAdapter#getPageTitle(int)} in the adapter supplied to * the ViewPager. * *

For an interactive indicator, see {@link PagerTabStrip}.
